description: This file contains the implementation of the Redis-based session handling class for the OpenCart system. It manages session data storage, retrieval, deletion, and lifecycle management using Redis as the backend, conforming to the session handler interface.
external_files: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash Registry
published: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Library	extbackslash Session	extbackslash Redis

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: Session handler class that uses Redis to store session data, providing methods to read, write, destroy, and perform garbage collection on session data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis session handler, establishing a connection to the Redis server and setting the session key prefix.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data stored under the given session ID, decoding JSON data into an array.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores session data as JSON-encoded string in Redis, setting expiration based on configuration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data associated with the provided session ID from Redis.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection; in Redis, it is handled automatically, so this method always returns true.
